content:
# Early bacterial proliferation: two groups compared with a GAM of log2 load over time
# Input: the per-fly table saved by CFU Drop Counter (Load step), one row per fly, with the
# inoculum tubes of the Time 0 plate at time 0, as in the protocol ("Early proliferation").
# The analysis itself is in prolif_core.R, which the R code tab gives with the settings chosen.
# Runs as a normal Shiny app, or in the browser with shinylive (no server).

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
if (FALSE) { library(svglite); library(jsonlite) }   # declares them to shinylive, which bundles the packages it finds in library() calls
has_svglite <- requireNamespace("svglite", quietly = TRUE)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
source("prolif_core.R")

APP_VERSION <- "1.0"
EXAMPLE_FILE <- "example_proliferation_CS_sexdim.csv"
EXAMPLE_TIME0 <- "example_time0_CS_sexdim.csv"
N_SIM <- 10000          # protocol, step 4
CONTROL_FRAC <- 0.1     # protocol, step 6d
PALETTE <- c("#1f5fbf", "#e8850c", "#2a9d6f", "#c0398a", "#7a5cc4", "#8c6d1f", "#3a3a3a", "#d1453b")
# Female orange and male blue in every app of the protocol, whatever the order
group_colours <- function(lv) {
  cols <- setNames(rep(NA_character_, length(lv)), lv)
  low <- tolower(lv)
  cols[low %in% c("female", "females", "f")] <- "#e8850c"
  cols[low %in% c("male", "males", "m")] <- "#1f5fbf"
  free <- setdiff(PALETTE, cols)
  cols[is.na(cols)] <- rep(free, length.out = sum(is.na(cols)))
  cols
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ reading
read_any <- function(path) {
  first <- readLines(path, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
  seps <- c(";" = ";", "," = ",", "\t" = "\t")
  counts <- sapply(seps, function(s) lengths(regmatches(first, gregexpr(s, first, fixed = TRUE))))
  sep <- if (max(counts) > 0) seps[[which.max(counts)]] else ""
  read.table(path, header = TRUE, sep = sep, quote = "\"'", dec = ".", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
             check.names = FALSE, comment.char = "", strip.white = TRUE, na.strings = c("NA", ""))
}
guess <- function(cols, candidates) { hit <- candidates[candidates %in% cols]; if (length(hit)) hit[1] else "" }
num <- function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) x else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub(",", ".", trimws(as.character(x)), fixed = TRUE)))
chr <- function(x) { x <- trimws(as.character(x)); x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "NA"; x }
default_order <- function(values) {
  lv <- sort(unique(chr(values)))
  first <- grepl("^(wild|wt([^a-z]|$)|control|ctrl)", tolower(lv))
  c(lv[first], lv[!first])
}
order_levels <- function(values, text) {
  all_lv <- sort(unique(chr(values)))
  given <- trimws(strsplit(text %||% "", ",")[[1]])
  c(given[given %in% all_lv], setdiff(all_lv, given))
}
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < 1e-16, "< 1e-16", ifelse(p < 0.001, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1), formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))))
pstat <- function(p) ifelse(p < 1e-16, "p < 1e-16", paste("p =", fmt_p(p)))
PARAM_TEXT <- c(growth = "growth", lag = "lag", onset = "onset of control", control = "time to control", max = "maximum load")
f1 <- function(v, d = 2) ifelse(is.finite(v), formatC(v, format = "f", digits = d), "")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ downloads
# Files are made in R and handed to the browser as a data URL, which works under shinylive.
dl_button <- function(id, label) actionButton(id, label, icon = icon("download"), class = "btn-outline-secondary btn-sm me-1")
DL_JS <- "
Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('send-file', function(m) {
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = 'data:' + m.mime + ';base64,' + m.data;
  a.download = m.name;
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
});"
send_file <- function(session, name, mime, write_fun) {
  f <- tempfile(fileext = paste0(".", tools::file_ext(name)))
  write_fun(f)
  data <- jsonlite::base64_enc(readBin(f, "raw", file.info(f)$size))
  session$sendCustomMessage("send-file", list(name = name, mime = mime, data = gsub("\n", "", data)))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ reports
params_table <- function(tab, lv) {
  p <- tab$params
  out <- data.frame(Parameter = p$Parameter,
                    a = fmt_ci(p$est1, p$low1, p$high1, 2), b = fmt_ci(p$est2, p$low2, p$high2, 2),
                    d = fmt_ci(p$diff, p$diff_low, p$diff_high, 2),
                    i90 = ifelse(is.finite(p$diff_low90), paste0("[", f1(p$diff_low90), ", ", f1(p$diff_high90), "]"), ""),
                    m = ifelse(is.finite(p$margin), paste0("±", p$margin), ""),
                    dr = sprintf("%.1f", p$draws_both), v = p$verdict, check.names = FALSE)
  names(out) <- c("Parameter", paste(lv[1], "[95% interval]"), paste(lv[2], "[95% interval]"),
                  paste(lv[2], "-", lv[1], "[95% interval]"), "90% interval of the difference", "Margin",
                  "Draws with the parameter in both groups (%)", "Reading")
  out
}

# The methods paragraph, as short paragraphs: a character vector, one element per paragraph
# 'info': flies per group, flies left out (by group and time), and the dose measured at time zero
PARAM_UNIT <- c(growth = " doublings/h", lag = " h", onset = " h", control = " h", max = " log2 CFU")
methods_text <- function(all, tabs, s, info) {
  lv <- s$lv
  first <- Filter(function(r) !inherits(r, "error"), all)[[1]]
  mg <- s$margins[is.finite(s$margins)]
  nl <- length(info$left)
  versions <- sprintf("%s, mgcv %s", sub("R version ([0-9.]+).*", "R \\1", R.version.string), as.character(packageVersion("mgcv")))
  intro <- c(
    paste0("The bacterial load of each fly was estimated by maximum likelihood from its colony counts across the dilution series, with CFU Drop Counter, and analysed in log2. ",
           sprintf("The analysis used %s%s.", paste(sprintf("%d flies of %s", info$n[lv], lv), collapse = " and "),
                   if (info$n_rep > 1) sprintf(", over %d replicate experiments", info$n_rep) else ""),
           if (nzchar(s$filter_col) && length(s$filter_vals)) sprintf(" Flies with %s = %s were analysed.", s$filter_col, paste(s$filter_vals, collapse = ", ")) else "",
           if (nl == 1) sprintf(" One fly without a load estimate was left out (%s).", info$left) else
           if (nl > 1) sprintf(" %d flies without a load estimate were left out (%s).", nl, paste(info$left, collapse = "; ")) else ""),
    sprintf("The inoculum was measured in %d tubes injected into PBS (median %.1f log2 bacteria per injection). It entered the model once, as observations at time 0, and is the common start of both curves.",
            info$n_t0, info$dose),
    sprintf("Log2 load was modelled against time post-injection with a generalized additive model: a smooth for %s and, for %s, a difference smooth entered through an ordered factor, each with basis dimension k = %d and with smoothing parameters estimated by REML. The difference smooth was constrained to zero at time 0.",
            lv[1], lv[2], first$k_use),
    sprintf("Uncertainty was obtained from %s coefficient vectors drawn from the fitted model, with the covariance including the uncertainty in the smoothing parameters (random seed %d); 95%% intervals are the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles across the draws. Whether the groups differ was assessed by a simultaneous 95%% band of the difference curve, computed from the same draws, and by the approximate test of the difference smooth.",
            format(N_SIM, big.mark = ","), s$seed),
    sprintf("Five parameters were read from each curve: growth, the steepest slope (doublings per hour); lag, the time at which the tangent at the steepest point crosses the fitted load at time 0; onset of control, the time of the steepest slope; time to control, the first time after it at which the slope falls below %.0f%% of its maximum; and the maximum load within the window. Each parameter and each difference between the groups is given with its 95%% interval%s.",
            100 * CONTROL_FRAC,
            if (length(mg)) paste0("; a parameter was called equivalent between the groups when the 90% interval of its difference fell within a margin set before the data were examined (", paste(sprintf("%s ± %s%s", PARAM_TEXT[names(mg)], mg, PARAM_UNIT[names(mg)]), collapse = ", "), ")") else ""),
    paste0(if (s$replicate != "") "Each replicate experiment was fitted separately. " else "",
           sprintf("Time points used: %s h. Analysis made with the Fly Proliferation app version %s (%s).", paste(s$times_used, collapse = ", "), APP_VERSION, versions)))
  res_par <- unlist(lapply(names(all), function(nm) {
    res <- all[[nm]]; tab <- tabs[[nm]]
    head <- if (nm != "All") paste0(nm, ". ") else ""
    if (inherits(res, "error")) return(sprintf("%sThe model could not be fitted (%s).", head, conditionMessage(res)))
    st <- res$smooth_test; p <- tab$params; kc <- res$kcheck; be <- res$band_excl
    side <- function(sg) ifelse(grepl("above", sg), paste(lv[2], "higher than", lv[1]), paste(lv[2], "lower than", lv[1]))
    c(paste0(head, "Results. The simultaneous 95% band of the difference ",
             if (nrow(be)) paste0("excluded zero from ", paste(sprintf("%.1f to %.1f h (%s)", be$From, be$To, side(be$Sign)), collapse = " and "), ". ") else "included zero over the whole window. ",
             sprintf("The difference smooth (%s - %s) had edf = %.2f, F = %.1f, approximate %s. ", lv[2], lv[1], st$edf[2], st$F[2], pstat(st$p[2])),
             sprintf("The basis check (k' = %d) gave k-index = %.2f with %s for the smooth of %s, and %s for the difference smooth.",
                     kc$k[1], kc$k_index[1], pstat(kc$p[1]), lv[1], pstat(kc$p[2]))),
      paste(c("Parameters, estimate [95% interval]:",
              sprintf("- %s (%s): %s %s; %s %s; difference %s (%s)", PARAM_TEXT[p$key], trimws(PARAM_UNIT[p$key]), lv[1], fmt_ci(p$est1, p$low1, p$high1, 2),
                      lv[2], fmt_ci(p$est2, p$low2, p$high2, 2), fmt_ci(p$diff, p$diff_low, p$diff_high, 2), p$verdict)), collapse = "\n"),
      paste0(if (any(!tab$peak)) paste0("For ", paste(lv[!tab$peak], collapse = " and "), ", the maximum is the load at the end of the window, not a peak. ") else "",
             if (any(p$draws_both < 99.5)) paste0("Not every draw reached every parameter within the window (reached in both groups: ", paste(sprintf("%s, %.1f%% of draws", PARAM_TEXT[p$key[p$draws_both < 99.5]], p$draws_both[p$draws_both < 99.5]), collapse = "; "),
                                                  "); the intervals describe the draws in which they were reached.") else ""))
  }))
  out <- c(intro, res_par)
  out[nzchar(out)]
}

r_code <- function(s) {
  core <- paste(readLines("prolif_core.R", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
  mg <- paste(sprintf("%s = %s", names(s$margins), ifelse(is.finite(s$margins), s$margins, "NA")), collapse = ", ")
  cols <- group_colours(s$lv)
  paste0(core, '

# ================================================================== analysis
# Runs on the table downloaded from the Flies tab of the app ("Proliferation_flies.csv")
pf <- read.csv("Proliferation_flies.csv")
d <- subset(pf, used == "yes")
d$group <- factor(d$group, levels = c(', paste0('"', s$lv, '"', collapse = ", "), '))   # first = reference, carries the inoculum
margins <- c(', mg, ')   # set before the data were examined; NA = none
cols <- c(', paste(sprintf('"%s" = "%s"', names(cols), cols), collapse = ", "), ')

for (r in unique(d$replicate)) {                  # each replicate experiment separately
  x <- d[d$replicate == r, ]
  res <- prolif_fit(x, k = ', s$k, ', n_sim = ', N_SIM, ', seed = ', s$seed, ', control_frac = ', CONTROL_FRAC, ')
  tab <- prolif_summary(res, margins)
  cat("\\n==== ", r, "\\n")
  print(res$smooth_test)        # step 2: the difference smooth tests whether the groups differ
  print(res$kcheck)             # step 3: basis check
  print(res$band_excl)          # step 5: where the simultaneous band excludes zero
  print(tab$params)             # steps 6, 8, 9
  print(tab$exist)              # draws in which each quantity exists
  ggsave(paste0("Proliferation_curves_", r, ".pdf"), plot_curves(res, tab, cols), width = 11, height = 8.5)
}
')
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ server
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  rv <- reactiveValues(d = NULL, name = NULL, d0 = NULL, name0 = NULL)
  observeEvent(input$file, {
    d <- tryCatch(read_any(input$file$datapath), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(d)) { showNotification("This file could not be read as a table.", type = "error"); return() }
    rv$d <- d; rv$name <- input$file$name
  })
  observeEvent(input$file0, {
    d <- tryCatch(read_any(input$file0$datapath), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(d)) { showNotification("The time zero file could not be read as a table.", type = "error"); return() }
    rv$d0 <- d; rv$name0 <- input$file0$name
  })
  observeEvent(input$use_example, {
    rv$d <- read_any(EXAMPLE_FILE); rv$name <- EXAMPLE_FILE
    rv$d0 <- read_any(EXAMPLE_TIME0); rv$name0 <- EXAMPLE_TIME0
    # the seed and the equivalence margins of the original analysis
    updateNumericInput(session, "seed", value = 99)
    updateNumericInput(session, "m_growth", value = 0.5); updateNumericInput(session, "m_lag", value = 1)
    updateNumericInput(session, "m_onset", value = 1); updateNumericInput(session, "m_control", value = 1)
    updateNumericInput(session, "m_max", value = 1)
  })

  observeEvent(rv$d, {
    cols <- names(rv$d); none <- c("(none)" = "")
    group_cols <- cols[vapply(rv$d, function(v) { n <- length(unique(v)); n >= 2 && n <= 30 }, TRUE)]
    load <- guess(cols, c("log2_CFU_per_fly", "log10_CFU_per_fly", "log2_load", "log10_load", "log2_CFU_fly", "log10_CFU_fly"))
    updateSelectInput(session, "time", choices = cols, selected = guess(cols, c("Time_post_injection", "Time.post.injection", "Time_point", "Time", "time")))
    updateSelectInput(session, "load_col", choices = cols, selected = load)
    updateRadioButtons(session, "load_base", selected = if (grepl("log10", load)) "10" else "2")
    updateSelectInput(session, "status_col", choices = c(none, cols), selected = guess(cols, c("Status", "status")))
    updateSelectInput(session, "lod_col", choices = c(none, cols), selected = guess(cols, c("LOD_per_fly", "LOD")))
    updateSelectInput(session, "id", choices = c("(none: row number)" = "", cols), selected = guess(cols, c("ID", "Fly_ID", "Sample_ID", "sampleID")))
    updateSelectInput(session, "group", choices = group_cols, selected = guess(group_cols, c("Sex", "Genotype", "Line", "Treatment")))
    updateSelectInput(session, "filter_col", choices = c(none, group_cols), selected = "")
    updateSelectInput(session, "replicate", choices = c(none, group_cols), selected = "")
  })
  observeEvent(input$filter_col, {
    vals <- if (nzchar(input$filter_col)) sort(unique(chr(rv$d[[input$filter_col]]))) else character(0)
    updateSelectizeInput(session, "filter_vals", choices = vals, selected = vals)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  times_all <- reactive({ req(rv$d, nzchar(input$time %||% "")); tt <- num(rv$d[[input$time]]); sort(unique(tt[is.finite(tt) & tt > 0])) })
  observeEvent(times_all(), updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "times", choices = times_all(), selected = times_all(), inline = TRUE))
  fly_groups <- reactive({ req(rv$d, nzchar(input$group %||% ""), nzchar(input$time %||% "")); tt <- num(rv$d[[input$time]]); chr(rv$d[[input$group]])[is.finite(tt) & tt > 0] })
  observeEvent(list(rv$d, input$group), { req(nzchar(input$group %||% "")); updateTextInput(session, "order", value = paste(default_order(fly_groups()), collapse = ", ")) })

  settings <- reactive({
    lv_all <- order_levels(fly_groups(), input$order)
    mg <- c(growth = input$m_growth, lag = input$m_lag, onset = input$m_onset, control = input$m_control, max = input$m_max)
    mg <- vapply(mg, function(v) if (is.null(v) || is.na(v) || v <= 0) NA_real_ else as.numeric(v), 0)
    list(group = input$group, lv_all = lv_all, time = input$time, load_col = input$load_col, load_base = as.numeric(input$load_base),
         status_col = input$status_col %||% "", lod_col = input$lod_col %||% "", id = input$id %||% "",
         filter_col = input$filter_col %||% "", filter_vals = input$filter_vals %||% character(0),
         replicate = input$replicate %||% "", times = num(input$times), k = max(3, round(input$k %||% 6)), seed = round(input$seed %||% 1),
         margins = mg, xlab = input$xlab)
  })

  # the time zero tubes: same columns as a per-fly table of CFU Drop Counter, found by name
  time0 <- reactive({
    s <- settings(); d0 <- rv$d0
    validate(need(!is.null(d0), "Load the time zero file too: the per-fly table of the Time 0 plate (tubes injected into PBS), saved by CFU Drop Counter. Both curves start at the dose it measures."))
    cols <- names(d0)
    lc <- if (s$load_col %in% cols) s$load_col else guess(cols, c("log2_CFU_per_fly", "log10_CFU_per_fly", "log2_load", "log10_load", "log2_CFU_fly", "log10_CFU_fly"))
    validate(need(nzchar(lc), sprintf("The time zero file has no load column (%s).", paste(cols, collapse = ", "))))
    base <- if (lc == s$load_col) s$load_base else if (grepl("log10", lc)) 10 else 2
    y <- num(d0[[lc]]) * log2(base)
    st <- if ("Status" %in% cols) as.character(d0$Status) else ifelse(is.finite(y), "Detected", "No load")
    data.frame(ID = if ("ID" %in% cols) as.character(d0$ID) else paste0("time 0 row ", seq_len(nrow(d0))),
               role = "inoculum", group_given = "Time 0", time = 0,
               replicate = if (nzchar(s$replicate) && s$replicate %in% cols) chr(d0[[s$replicate]]) else NA_character_,
               log2_load = y, log2_lod = if ("LOD_per_fly" %in% cols) log2(num(d0$LOD_per_fly)) else NA_real_,
               Status = st, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })

  # every fly and time zero tube, with its role and whether it enters the GAM
  flies <- reactive({
    s <- settings(); d <- rv$d; req(d, nzchar(s$time), nzchar(s$load_col), nzchar(s$group))
    tt <- num(d[[s$time]])
    validate(need(all(is.finite(tt)), sprintf("%d row(s) have a time that is not a number.", sum(!is.finite(tt)))),
             need(s$group != s$time, "The groups to compare cannot be the time column."),
             need(!(s$replicate %in% c(s$group, s$time)) || s$replicate == "", "The replicate must be a different column from the groups and the time."))
    y <- num(d[[s$load_col]]) * log2(s$load_base)                     # to log2
    status <- if (nzchar(s$status_col)) as.character(d[[s$status_col]]) else ifelse(is.finite(y), "Detected", "No load")
    lod <- if (nzchar(s$lod_col)) log2(num(d[[s$lod_col]])) else NA_real_
    keep <- tt > 0                                                     # time zero comes from its own file
    if (nzchar(s$filter_col) && length(s$filter_vals)) keep <- keep & chr(d[[s$filter_col]]) %in% s$filter_vals
    pf <- data.frame(ID = if (nzchar(s$id)) as.character(d[[s$id]]) else paste0("row ", seq_len(nrow(d))),
                     role = "fly", group_given = chr(d[[s$group]]), time = tt,
                     replicate = if (nzchar(s$replicate)) chr(d[[s$replicate]]) else "All",
                     log2_load = y, log2_lod = lod, Status = status, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[keep, ]
    lv <- intersect(s$lv_all, unique(pf$group_given))
    validate(need(length(lv) == 2, sprintf("The analysis compares two groups; %s holds %d among the flies kept (%s). Choose two with \"Keep only flies where\", or another column.",
                                           s$group, length(lv), paste(lv, collapse = ", "))))
    # time zero: each replicate its own tubes when the file says which; otherwise shared by all
    z <- time0()
    reps <- unique(pf$replicate)
    z <- if (all(is.na(z$replicate))) do.call(rbind, lapply(reps, function(r) transform(z, replicate = r))) else z[z$replicate %in% reps, ]
    pf <- rbind(z, pf)
    pf$group <- ifelse(pf$role == "inoculum", lv[1], pf$group_given)  # the dose belongs to neither group: bookkeeping
    pf$detected <- pf$Status == "Detected" & is.finite(pf$log2_load)
    pf$used <- ifelse(!pf$detected, paste0("no (", pf$Status, ")"),
                      ifelse(pf$role == "fly" & !(pf$time %in% s$times), "no (time point not used)", "yes"))
    validate(need(sum(pf$used == "yes" & pf$role == "inoculum") > 0, "No time zero tube has a load."),
             need(length(unique(pf$time[pf$used == "yes"])) >= 4, "At least three time points after injection are needed."))
    attr(pf, "lv") <- lv
    attr(pf, "t0_in_flies") <- sum(tt == 0)
    pf
  })
  lv <- reactive(attr(flies(), "lv"))
  reps <- reactive(unique(flies()$replicate))

  # steps 2 to 6: one fit per replicate (only on data, k, seed and time points)
  results <- reactive({
    pf <- flies(); s <- settings(); l <- lv()
    used <- pf[pf$used == "yes", ]
    out <- lapply(setNames(reps(), reps()), function(r) {
      x <- used[used$replicate == r, ]
      x$group <- factor(x$group, levels = l)
      if (!any(x$time == 0)) return(simpleError("no inoculum tube at time 0 in this replicate"))
      tryCatch(prolif_fit(x[, c("time", "group", "log2_load")], k = s$k, n_sim = N_SIM, seed = s$seed, control_frac = CONTROL_FRAC),
               error = function(e) e)
    })
    out
  })
  # steps 6, 8 and 9 (margins change no fit)
  tabs <- reactive({ s <- settings(); lapply(results(), function(r) if (inherits(r, "error")) r else prolif_summary(r, s$margins)) })

  output$data_info <- renderText({
    paste(if (is.null(rv$d)) "Flies: not loaded." else sprintf("Flies: %s, %d rows.", rv$name, nrow(rv$d)),
          if (is.null(rv$d0)) "Time zero: not loaded." else sprintf("Time zero: %s, %d tubes.", rv$name0, nrow(rv$d0)))
  })

  output$messages <- renderUI({
    if (is.null(rv$d) || is.null(rv$d0)) return(div(class = "alert alert-info", "Load the two tables saved by CFU Drop Counter (log2): the flies, and the time zero tubes injected into PBS. Or try the example."))
    pf <- tryCatch(flies(), error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(pf, "error")) return(div(class = "alert alert-danger", conditionMessage(pf)))
    w <- character(0)
    nd <- pf[pf$role == "fly" & !pf$detected & pf$time %in% settings()$times, ]
    if (nrow(nd)) {
      tb <- table(paste0(nd$group, " at ", nd$time, " h"))
      share <- tapply(!pf$detected[pf$role == "fly"], paste(pf$group, pf$time)[pf$role == "fly"], mean)
      w <- c(w, paste0("Flies without a load are left out of the GAM (", paste(sprintf("%s: %d", names(tb), tb), collapse = ", "), "), so the curve is fitted to the flies that have one",
                       if (max(share) > 0.1) "; at more than one fly in ten, this lifts the curve at those times. Report them, and consider analysing them as a binary outcome." else ". Report them."))
    }
    ids <- pf$ID[pf$role == "fly"]; dup <- unique(ids[duplicated(ids)])
    if (length(dup)) w <- c(w, sprintf("Some fly IDs appear more than once in the flies table (%s): check that no fly is entered twice.", paste(head(dup, 5), collapse = ", ")))
    if (attr(pf, "t0_in_flies") > 0) w <- c(w, sprintf("%d row(s) of the flies table are at time 0 and are not used: time zero comes from its own file.", attr(pf, "t0_in_flies")))
    inoc <- pf[pf$role == "inoculum" & !duplicated(pf$ID), ]
    if (any(!inoc$detected)) w <- c(w, sprintf("%d time zero tube(s) have no load and are left out.", sum(!inoc$detected)))
    for (nm in names(results())) {
      r <- results()[[nm]]; lab <- if (nm == "All") "" else paste0(nm, ": ")
      if (inherits(r, "error")) { w <- c(w, paste0(lab, if (nzchar(lab)) "the" else "The", " model could not be fitted (", conditionMessage(r), ").")); next }
      kc <- r$kcheck
      if (any(kc$p < 0.05 & kc$edf > 0.8 * kc$k)) w <- c(w, paste0(lab, if (nzchar(lab)) "the" else "The", " basis check suggests too little flexibility (k-index below 1 with a small p and edf close to k'). Increase k and refit."))
      if (r$k_use < r$k) w <- c(w, sprintf("%sk was lowered to %d, the number of time points minus one.", lab, r$k_use))
      tb <- tabs()[[nm]]
      if (any(tb$params$draws_both < 95)) w <- c(w, paste0(lab, if (nzchar(lab)) "some" else "Some", " parameters are missing in more than 5% of the draws (see Results); their intervals describe only the draws that reached them, the ones that reached them soonest."))
    }
    if (length(reps()) > 1) w <- c(w, "Each replicate is fitted separately. Report the differences of every replicate and their agreement (Results), rather than counting how many are significant.")
    if (length(w)) div(class = "alert alert-warning", tags$ul(lapply(w, tags$li)))
  })

  rep_pick <- function(id) renderUI(if (length(reps()) > 1) selectInput(id, "Replicate shown", reps(), selected = reps()[1]))
  output$rep_pick_curves <- rep_pick("rep_curves")
  output$rep_pick_flies <- rep_pick("rep_flies")
  pick <- function(v) if (!is.null(v) && v %in% reps()) v else reps()[1]

  the_curves <- reactive({
    r <- pick(input$rep_curves); res <- results()[[r]]; tab <- tabs()[[r]]
    validate(need(!inherits(res, "error"), "The model could not be fitted for this replicate."))
    p <- plot_curves(res, tab, group_colours(lv()), xlab = settings()$xlab)
    if (r != "All") p + patchwork::plot_annotation(title = r) else p
  })
  # same shape on screen as the saved file (11 x 8.5 in), whatever the width of the window
  output$curves <- renderPlot(the_curves(), res = 96, height = function() round(session$clientData$output_curves_width * 8.5 / 11))

  the_flies_plot <- reactive({
    r <- pick(input$rep_flies); pf <- flies(); s <- settings()
    fl <- pf[pf$replicate == r & (pf$role == "inoculum" | pf$time %in% s$times) & !grepl("^no \\((Above|Estimation)", pf$used), ]
    p <- plot_flies(fl, lv(), 0, group_colours(lv()), xlab = s$xlab)
    if (r != "All") p + ggtitle(r) else p
  })
  output$flies_plot <- renderPlot(the_flies_plot(), res = 96, height = function() round(session$clientData$output_flies_plot_width * 5 / 8))

  output$results_ui <- renderUI({
    l <- lv()
    blocks <- lapply(names(results()), function(nm) {
      res <- results()[[nm]]; tab <- tabs()[[nm]]
      if (inherits(res, "error")) return(p(sprintf("%s: the model could not be fitted (%s).", nm, conditionMessage(res))))
      st <- res$smooth_test; kc <- res$kcheck; be <- res$band_excl
      tagList(if (nm != "All") h5(nm),
        h6("Where the groups differ: simultaneous 95% band of the difference (step 5)"),
        p(if (nrow(be)) paste0("The band excludes zero from ", paste(sprintf("%.1f to %.1f h (%s)", be$From, be$To, be$Sign), collapse = "; "), ".")
          else "The band includes zero over the whole window: no difference is shown at any time."),
        p(class = "small text-muted", "This is the test of whether the groups differ at any time: in simulations of the protocol's design with no difference, the band excluded zero in about 6% of experiments, close to the 5% expected. At time 0 the difference is zero by construction, so where the band first excludes zero depends on the anchoring and the smoothing; it is not an estimate of when the groups began to diverge."),
        h6("Difference smooth (step 2)"),
        renderTable(transform(st, edf = f1(edf), F = f1(F), p = fmt_p(p))),
        p(class = "small text-muted", "The p-values of smooths are approximate. In the same simulations the difference smooth gave p < 0.05 in about 11% of experiments with no difference, twice the 5% expected: read it with the band, not instead of it."),
        h6(sprintf("Basis check, k = %d (step 3)", res$k_use)),
        renderTable(transform(kc, edf = f1(edf), k_index = f1(k_index), p = fmt_p(p))),
        p(class = "small text-muted", "A k-index below 1 with a small p and an edf close to k' means too little flexibility: increase k, and report how the parameters change."),
        h6(sprintf("Five parameters and their differences (steps 6, 8 and 9; seed %d, %s draws)", res$seed, format(res$n_sim, big.mark = ","))),
        renderTable(params_table(tab, l)),
        p(class = "small text-muted", "Five parameters were examined; weigh the pattern rather than one verdict. Growth, lag and onset of control are all read from the steepest point, so they are not independent. Differ: the 95% interval of the difference excludes 0 (\"differ, within margin\" when its 90% interval also lies within the margin: real, but smaller than the difference set as meaningful). Equivalent: the 90% interval lies within the margin. A non-significant difference is not evidence of equality."),
        h6("Draws in which each quantity exists"),
        renderTable(tab$exist, digits = 1),
        if (any(!tab$peak)) p(sprintf("For %s, the maximum is the load at the last time point, not a peak: label it as such.", paste(l[!tab$peak], collapse = " and "))),
        h6("Flies and inoculum tubes in the model"), renderTable(as.data.frame(t(res$n))))
    })
    per_rep <- NULL
    ok <- Filter(function(t) !inherits(t, "error"), tabs())
    if (length(ok) > 1) {
      pr <- do.call(cbind, lapply(ok, function(t) fmt_ci(t$params$diff, t$params$diff_low, t$params$diff_high, 2)))
      per_rep <- tagList(h5(sprintf("Differences per replicate, %s - %s [95%% interval]", l[2], l[1])),
                         renderTable(data.frame(Parameter = PARAM_NAMES, pr, check.names = FALSE)))
    }
    tagList(per_rep, blocks)
  })

  results_csv <- reactive({
    do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tabs()), function(nm) {
      t <- tabs()[[nm]]; if (inherits(t, "error")) return(NULL)
      p <- t$params; p$key <- NULL
      names(p)[2:7] <- c(paste0(lv()[1], c("", "_low95", "_high95")), paste0(lv()[2], c("", "_low95", "_high95")))
      cbind(Replicate = nm, p)
    }))
  })

  pf_out <- reactive({
    pf <- flies()
    data.frame(ID = pf$ID, role = pf$role, group = pf$group, group_given = pf$group_given, time = pf$time,
               replicate = pf$replicate, log2_load = pf$log2_load, Status = pf$Status, used = pf$used)
  })
  output$pf_table <- renderTable(head(pf_out(), 60))

  methods <- reactive({
    s <- settings(); s$lv <- lv(); s$times_used <- sort(c(0, s$times)); pf <- flies()
    fl <- pf[pf$role == "fly" & pf$time %in% s$times, ]
    t0 <- pf[pf$role == "inoculum" & pf$used == "yes" & !duplicated(pf$ID), ]
    left <- fl[!fl$detected, ]
    info <- list(n = table(factor(fl$group[fl$used == "yes"], levels = lv())),
                 left = if (nrow(left)) sprintf("%s at %s h%s, %s", left$group, left$time,
                                                if (nzchar(s$replicate)) paste0(" in ", left$replicate) else "", tolower(left$Status)) else character(0),
                 n_rep = length(unique(fl$replicate)),
                 n_t0 = nrow(t0), dose = median(t0$log2_load))
    methods_text(results(), tabs(), s, info)
  })
  output$methods <- renderUI(lapply(methods(), function(x) p(style = "white-space: pre-line", x)))
  code <- reactive({ s <- settings(); s$lv <- lv(); r_code(s) })
  output$rcode <- renderText(code())

  observeEvent(input$dl_pdf, send_file(session, "Proliferation_curves.pdf", "application/pdf", function(f) ggsave(f, the_curves(), width = 11, height = 8.5)))
  observeEvent(input$dl_png, send_file(session, "Proliferation_curves.png", "image/png", function(f) ggsave(f, the_curves(), width = 11, height = 8.5, dpi = 300)))
  observeEvent(input$dl_svg, send_file(session, "Proliferation_curves.svg", "image/svg+xml", function(f) ggsave(f, the_curves(), width = 11, height = 8.5, device = svglite::svglite)))
  observeEvent(input$dl_pdf2, send_file(session, "Proliferation_flies.pdf", "application/pdf", function(f) ggsave(f, the_flies_plot(), width = 8, height = 5)))
  observeEvent(input$dl_png2, send_file(session, "Proliferation_flies.png", "image/png", function(f) ggsave(f, the_flies_plot(), width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)))
  observeEvent(input$dl_svg2, send_file(session, "Proliferation_flies.svg", "image/svg+xml", function(f) ggsave(f, the_flies_plot(), width = 8, height = 5, device = svglite::svglite)))
  observeEvent(input$dl_results, send_file(session, "Proliferation_results.csv", "text/csv", function(f) write.table(results_csv(), f, sep = ";", row.names = FALSE)))
  observeEvent(input$dl_pf, send_file(session, "Proliferation_flies.csv", "text/csv", function(f) write.csv(pf_out(), f, row.names = FALSE)))
  observeEvent(input$dl_methods, send_file(session, "Proliferation_methods.txt", "text/plain", function(f) writeLines(paste(methods(), collapse = "\n\n"), f)))
  observeEvent(input$dl_code, send_file(session, "Proliferation_analysis.R", "text/plain", function(f) writeLines(code(), f)))
}

content:
# Early bacterial proliferation: comparison of two groups with a GAM
# As in the protocol, "Quantification and statistical analysis", section "Early proliferation".
# The Fly Proliferation app runs these functions, and its R code tab gives this file with the
# settings chosen, so the analysis can be rerun in R without the app.
#
# Input: one row per fly (and per inoculum tube), with
#   time       hours post-injection; the inoculum, measured by injecting into PBS, at time 0
#   group      factor with two levels; the first is the reference. The inoculum rows carry the
#              reference level: the dose was measured in PBS and belongs to neither group, the
#              level is bookkeeping (protocol, step 2)
#   log2_load  log2 bacteria per fly (CFU Drop Counter, Load step), flies with a load only

library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

PARAM_NAMES <- c(growth = "Growth (doublings/h)", lag = "Lag (h)", onset = "Onset of control (h)",
                 control = "Time to control (h)", max = "Maximum (log2 CFU)")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ steps 2 to 6
# Fit the GAM, draw coefficient vectors, and compute the curves, the simultaneous band of the
# difference and the five parameters of each curve, for the fit and for every draw.
prolif_fit <- function(d, k = 6, n_sim = 10000, seed = 1, control_frac = 0.1, n_grid = 200) {
  lv <- levels(d$group)
  stopifnot("two groups are needed" = length(lv) == 2)
  t0 <- min(d$time)
  if (any(d$time == t0 & d$group != lv[1]))
    stop("rows at time ", t0, " must carry the reference level (", lv[1], ")")
  # k.check and the draws are random: set the seed, and give the caller back its own random state
  old_seed <- if (exists(".Random.seed", envir = globalenv())) get(".Random.seed", envir = globalenv()) else NULL
  on.exit(if (is.null(old_seed)) rm(".Random.seed", envir = globalenv()) else assign(".Random.seed", old_seed, envir = globalenv()))
  set.seed(seed)
  d$groupO <- ordered(d$group, levels = lv)
  k_use <- min(k, length(unique(d$time)) - 1)

  # Step 2: one smooth for the reference, a difference smooth for the other group through an
  # ordered factor, each penalized by REML; the difference smooth is constrained to 0 at t0.
  # Its p-value (summary) is approximate: in simulations of the protocol's design with no
  # difference, it was below 0.05 in about 11% of experiments. The simultaneous band (step 5)
  # held its level (about 6%), so it is the one to read for whether the groups differ.
  fit <- gam(log2_load ~ s(time, k = k_use) + s(time, by = groupO, k = k_use, pc = t0),
             data = d, method = "REML")
  st <- summary(fit)$s.table
  smooth_test <- data.frame(Term = c(paste("Smooth of", lv[1]), paste("Difference smooth,", lv[2], "-", lv[1])),
                            edf = st[, "edf"], F = st[, "F"], p = st[, "p-value"], row.names = NULL)
  # Step 3: basis check
  kc <- k.check(fit)
  kcheck <- data.frame(Term = smooth_test$Term, k = kc[, "k'"], edf = kc[, "edf"],
                       k_index = kc[, "k-index"], p = kc[, "p-value"], row.names = NULL)

  # Step 4: draws, with the covariance that includes the uncertainty in the smoothing
  V <- vcov(fit, unconditional = TRUE)
  b <- coef(fit)
  draws <- rmvn(n_sim, b, V)

  tgrid <- seq(t0, max(d$time), length.out = n_grid)
  newd <- expand.grid(time = tgrid, group = factor(lv, levels = lv))
  newd$groupO <- ordered(newd$group, levels = lv)
  h <- 0.01                                                           # slope by finite difference
  X <- predict(fit, newd, type = "lpmatrix")
  D <- (predict(fit, transform(newd, time = time + h), type = "lpmatrix") - X) / h
  r1 <- newd$group == lv[1]; r2 <- newd$group == lv[2]

  band <- function(M) {                                               # pointwise 95%
    est <- drop(M %*% b); se <- sqrt(pmax(rowSums((M %*% V) * M), 0))
    data.frame(est = est, low = est - 1.96 * se, high = est + 1.96 * se)
  }
  # Step 5: simultaneous 95% band of the difference, from the draws
  Mdiff <- X[r2, , drop = FALSE] - X[r1, , drop = FALSE]
  dif <- band(Mdiff)
  se_d <- (dif$high - dif$est) / 1.96
  ok <- se_d > 1e-8                                                   # se = 0 at t0, by construction
  dev <- abs((draws - rep(b, each = n_sim)) %*% t(Mdiff[ok, , drop = FALSE])) / rep(se_d[ok], each = n_sim)
  crit <- unname(quantile(dev[cbind(seq_len(n_sim), max.col(dev, ties.method = "first"))], 0.95))
  dif$low <- dif$est - crit * se_d; dif$high <- dif$est + crit * se_d
  excl <- dif$low > 0 | dif$high < 0
  rr <- rle(excl); ends <- cumsum(rr$lengths); starts <- ends - rr$lengths + 1
  band_excl <- data.frame(From = tgrid[starts][rr$values], To = tgrid[ends][rr$values],
                          Sign = ifelse(dif$est[starts][rr$values] > 0, paste(lv[2], "above"), paste(lv[2], "below")))

  curves <- rbind(
    data.frame(panel = 1, group = rep(lv, each = n_grid), time = tgrid, rbind(band(X[r1, ]), band(X[r2, ]))),
    data.frame(panel = 2, group = rep(lv, each = n_grid), time = tgrid, rbind(band(D[r1, ]), band(D[r2, ]))),
    data.frame(panel = 3, group = "Difference", time = tgrid, dif))

  # Step 6: the five parameters, for the fitted curves and for every draw
  par_of <- function(Fm, Dm) {                    # Fm, Dm: one row per curve, one column per grid time
    n <- nrow(Fm); idx <- seq_len(n)
    i <- max.col(Dm, ties.method = "first")       # t*: steepest point
    growth <- Dm[cbind(idx, i)]
    fi <- Fm[cbind(idx, i)]; f0 <- Fm[, 1]
    below <- (col(Dm) > i) & (Dm <= control_frac * growth)
    has <- rowSums(below) > 0
    j <- max.col(below * 1, ties.method = "first")
    im <- max.col(Fm, ties.method = "first")
    data.frame(growth = growth,
               lag = ifelse(growth > 0, tgrid[i] - (fi - f0) / growth, NA),
               onset = tgrid[i],
               control = ifelse(has, tgrid[j], NA),          # NA: not reached in the window
               max = Fm[cbind(idx, im)],
               t_max = tgrid[im], y_growth = fi, y_start = f0,
               y_control = ifelse(has, Dm[cbind(idx, j)], NA))
  }
  est <- sim <- list()
  for (g in lv) {
    Xg <- X[newd$group == g, ]; Dg <- D[newd$group == g, ]
    est[[g]] <- par_of(rbind(drop(Xg %*% b)), rbind(drop(Dg %*% b)))
    sim[[g]] <- par_of(draws %*% t(Xg), draws %*% t(Dg))
  }
  list(fit = fit, lv = lv, t0 = t0, k = k, k_use = k_use, seed = seed, n_sim = n_sim,
       control_frac = control_frac, tgrid = tgrid, curves = curves, band_crit = crit,
       band_excl = band_excl, smooth_test = smooth_test, kcheck = kcheck, est = est, sim = sim,
       data = d[, c("time", "group", "log2_load")],
       n = c(inoculum = sum(d$time == t0), table(droplevels(d$group[d$time > t0]))))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ steps 6, 8 and 9
# Each parameter with its 95% interval, the difference with its 95% interval, and, where a
# margin was set before the data were examined, equivalence from the 90% interval.
prolif_summary <- function(res, margins = c(growth = NA, lag = NA, onset = NA, control = NA, max = NA)) {
  lv <- res$lv; e1 <- res$est[[lv[1]]]; e2 <- res$est[[lv[2]]]; s1 <- res$sim[[lv[1]]]; s2 <- res$sim[[lv[2]]]
  end <- max(res$tgrid)
  qnt <- function(x, p) if (sum(is.finite(x)) > 1) unname(quantile(x, p, na.rm = TRUE)) else c(NA, NA)
  rows <- lapply(names(PARAM_NAMES), function(p) {
    x <- s2[[p]] - s1[[p]]; both <- is.finite(x)
    d_est <- e2[[p]] - e1[[p]]
    ci <- qnt(x, c(0.025, 0.975)); ci90 <- qnt(x, c(0.05, 0.95))
    m <- if (p %in% names(margins)) as.numeric(margins[[p]]) else NA_real_
    differ <- all(is.finite(ci)) && (ci[1] > 0 || ci[2] < 0)
    within <- is.finite(m) && all(is.finite(ci90)) && ci90[1] > -m && ci90[2] < m
    verdict <- if (!is.finite(d_est)) "not reached" else
      if (differ && within) "differ, within margin" else      # real, but smaller than the margin
      if (differ) "differ" else
      if (!is.finite(m)) "no margin set" else
      if (within) "equivalent" else "inconclusive"
    data.frame(Parameter = PARAM_NAMES[[p]], key = p,
               est1 = e1[[p]], low1 = qnt(s1[[p]], 0.025)[1], high1 = qnt(s1[[p]], 0.975)[1],
               est2 = e2[[p]], low2 = qnt(s2[[p]], 0.025)[1], high2 = qnt(s2[[p]], 0.975)[1],
               diff = d_est, diff_low = ci[1], diff_high = ci[2], diff_low90 = ci90[1], diff_high90 = ci90[2],
               margin = m, draws_both = 100 * mean(both), verdict = verdict, row.names = NULL)
  })
  params <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  # the maximum is a peak only when it is reached before the end of the window
  peak <- c(e1$t_max < end, e2$t_max < end)
  exist <- data.frame(Quantity = c("Lag defined (steepest slope > 0)", "Time to control reached", "Maximum is a peak, not the end of the window"),
                      g1 = 100 * c(mean(is.finite(s1$lag)), mean(is.finite(s1$control)), mean(s1$t_max < end)),
                      g2 = 100 * c(mean(is.finite(s2$lag)), mean(is.finite(s2$control)), mean(s2$t_max < end)))
  names(exist)[2:3] <- paste0(lv, " (% of draws)")
  list(params = params, exist = exist, peak = setNames(peak, lv))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ figure
# The protocol's figure: fitted log2 load, growth rate, difference, and the five parameters.
fmt_ci <- function(est, low, high, digits = 1) {
  f <- function(v) ifelse(is.finite(v), formatC(v, format = "f", digits = digits), "n.r.")
  ifelse(is.finite(est), paste0(f(est), " [", f(low), ", ", f(high), "]"), "not reached")
}

plot_curves <- function(res, tab, cols, xlab = "Time post-injection (h)") {
  lv <- res$lv; e <- res$est; p <- tab$params
  cv <- res$curves
  pts <- res$data
  pts$group <- ifelse(pts$time == res$t0, "Start", as.character(pts$group))
  ci <- function(g, k) quantile(res$sim[[g]][[k]], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  nudge <- setNames(c(-0.35, 0.35), lv)               # the two lag points share the start level
  marks <- do.call(rbind, lapply(lv, function(g) {
    x <- e[[g]]
    data.frame(group = g, panel = c(1, 1, 2, 2),
               x = c(x$lag, x$t_max, x$onset, x$control),
               y = c(x$y_start + nudge[[g]], x$max, x$growth, x$y_control),
               xlo = c(ci(g, "lag")[1], NA, ci(g, "onset")[1], ci(g, "control")[1]),
               xhi = c(ci(g, "lag")[2], NA, ci(g, "onset")[2], ci(g, "control")[2]),
               ylo = c(NA, ci(g, "max")[1], ci(g, "growth")[1], NA),
               yhi = c(NA, ci(g, "max")[2], ci(g, "growth")[2], NA))
  }))
  marks <- marks[is.finite(marks$x) & is.finite(marks$y), ]
  tangent <- do.call(rbind, lapply(lv, function(g) {
    x <- e[[g]]; data.frame(group = g, x = x$lag, xend = x$onset, y = x$y_start + nudge[[g]], yend = x$y_growth)
  }))
  tangent <- tangent[is.finite(tangent$x), ]
  div <- data.frame(x = res$band_excl$From); div <- div[div$x > res$t0, , drop = FALSE]

  allcols <- c(cols[lv], Start = "grey35", Difference = "black")
  sc <- function(keys, legend) list(
    scale_colour_manual(values = allcols, breaks = keys, limits = names(allcols), name = NULL),
    scale_fill_manual(values = allcols, breaks = keys, limits = names(allcols), name = NULL),
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(res$data$time))),
    theme_classic(base_size = 11),
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)),
    if (!legend) guides(colour = "none", fill = "none"))
  mk <- function(k) list(
    geom_segment(data = marks[marks$panel == k & !is.na(marks$xlo), ], inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x = xlo, xend = xhi, y = y, yend = y, colour = group), linewidth = 0.7),
    geom_segment(data = marks[marks$panel == k & !is.na(marks$ylo), ], inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x = x, xend = x, y = ylo, yend = yhi, colour = group), linewidth = 0.7),
    geom_point(data = marks[marks$panel == k, ], inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group),
               shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 2.6, stroke = 1.1))
  curve <- function(k) ggplot(cv[cv$panel == k, ], aes(time, est, colour = group, fill = group)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = low, ymax = high), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.9)

  p_load <- curve(1) +
    geom_point(data = pts, aes(time, log2_load, colour = group), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1, alpha = 0.45) +
    geom_segment(data = tangent, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend, colour = group),
                 linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.6) +
    mk(1) + sc(c(lv, "Start"), TRUE) + labs(title = "Fitted load", x = xlab, y = "log2 CFU per fly")
  p_rate <- curve(2) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
    mk(2) + sc(lv, FALSE) + labs(title = "Growth rate", x = xlab, y = "Doublings per hour")
  p_diff <- curve(3) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(data = div, aes(xintercept = x), linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey30") +
    geom_text(data = div, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = x, y = Inf, label = paste0("differ from ", round(x, 1), " h")),
              hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.3) +
    sc("Difference", FALSE) + labs(title = paste0("Difference, ", lv[2], " - ", lv[1]), x = xlab, y = "log2 difference")

  # the five parameters: the difference, its 95% interval and the reading
  short <- c(growth = "Growth (doublings/h)", lag = "Lag (h)", onset = "Onset of control (h)", control = "Time to control (h)", max = "Maximum (log2 CFU)")
  tb <- data.frame(y = rev(seq_len(nrow(p))), par = short[p$key], d = fmt_ci(p$diff, p$diff_low, p$diff_high), v = p$verdict)
  hdr <- nrow(p) + 1.2
  p_tab <- ggplot(tb) +
    geom_text(aes(0, y, label = par), hjust = 0, size = 3.4) +
    geom_text(aes(0.45, y, label = d), hjust = 0, size = 3.4) +
    geom_text(aes(0.82, y, label = v, fontface = ifelse(startsWith(v, "differ"), "bold", "plain")), hjust = 0, size = 3.2) +
    annotate("text", x = c(0, 0.45, 0.82), y = hdr, label = c("Parameter", "Difference\n[95% interval]", "Reading"), vjust = 0.3, lineheight = 0.9,
             hjust = 0, size = 3.4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = 1.02, y = hdr - 0.65, yend = hdr - 0.65, linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.4, hdr + 0.7)) +
    labs(title = paste0("Five parameters examined, ", lv[2], " - ", lv[1])) + theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 15))

  (p_load + p_rate) / (p_diff + p_tab) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(caption = paste0(
      "GAM fits with 95% bands (simultaneous for the difference), including smoothing uncertainty; both groups start at the dose measured at time 0.\n",
      "Fitted load: end of the lag (dotted tangent at the steepest point) and maximum. Growth rate: fastest growth = onset of control, and time to control\n",
      "(growth below ", 100 * res$control_frac, "% of its maximum). Bars: 95% intervals from ", format(res$n_sim, big.mark = ","), " draws. ",
      "Difference: dotted line from where the simultaneous band excludes 0.\n",
      "Readings: differ = 95% interval excludes 0; equivalent = 90% interval within the margin set beforehand; otherwise inconclusive. n.r.: not reached by ",
      max(res$tgrid), " h."),
      theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8.5))) &
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}

# Individual flies over time, with medians from the common start and the detection limit.
# 'fl': time, group, log2_load (NA when not detected), log2_lod, detected (TRUE/FALSE)
plot_flies <- function(fl, lv, t0, cols, xlab = "Time post-injection (h)") {
  fl$grp <- ifelse(fl$time == t0, "Start", as.character(fl$group))
  off <- c(setNames(c(-0.17, 0.17), lv), Start = 0)
  fl$y <- ifelse(fl$detected, fl$log2_load, fl$log2_lod)
  fl <- fl[is.finite(fl$y), ]
  fl$x <- fl$time + off[fl$grp]
  fl$Status <- ifelse(fl$detected, "Detected", "Not detected (at its detection limit)")
  med <- aggregate(y ~ grp + time, data = fl, FUN = median)
  med$x <- med$time + off[med$grp]
  m0 <- med[med$grp == "Start", ]
  lines <- rbind(med[med$grp != "Start", ], transform(m0, grp = lv[1]), transform(m0, grp = lv[2]))
  lod <- if (any(is.finite(fl$log2_lod))) aggregate(log2_lod ~ time, data = fl, FUN = median) else data.frame(time = numeric(0), log2_lod = numeric(0))
  allcols <- c(cols[lv], Start = "grey35")
  ggplot(fl, aes(x, y, colour = grp)) +
    geom_segment(data = lod, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = time - 0.4, xend = time + 0.4, y = log2_lod, yend = log2_lod),
                 linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Status), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.6, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
    geom_line(data = lines, aes(x, y, group = grp), linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = med, aes(x, y), size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = allcols, breaks = names(allcols), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Detected" = 16, "Not detected (at its detection limit)" = 1), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(fl$time))) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = expression("Bacterial load (" * log[2] ~ "CFU per fly)"),
         caption = "Points: individual flies, and the injected dose at time 0. Lines: medians from the common start. Dashed: detection limit.") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "top", plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8))
}

# Checks how often the Fly Proliferation analysis finds a difference between two groups when
# there is none. Both groups are drawn from the same curve: the curve fitted to the females of the
# example, with the within-group SD observed at each time, on the protocol's design (8 time zero
# tubes, 8 flies per group per hour from 1 to 12 h). Each test should call about 5% of these
# experiments different. Run from the repository folder: Rscript tools/simulate_no_difference.R
source("app_proliferation/prolif_core.R")
a <- read.table("app_proliferation/example_proliferation_CS_sexdim.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";")
z <- read.table("app_proliferation/example_time0_CS_sexdim.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";")
a <- a[a$Status == "Detected" & a$Sex == "Female", ]
d <- rbind(data.frame(time = 0, log2_load = z$log2_CFU_per_fly), data.frame(time = a$Time_post_injection, log2_load = a$log2_CFU_per_fly))
truth <- gam(log2_load ~ s(time, k = 6), data = d, method = "REML")
sd_t <- tapply(residuals(truth), d$time, sd)
mu <- function(t) predict(truth, data.frame(time = t))

R <- 200                      # experiments simulated
set.seed(2026); out <- NULL
for (r in seq_len(R)) {
  t <- rep(1:12, each = 8)
  x <- rbind(data.frame(time = 0, group = "A", log2_load = rnorm(8, mu(0), sd_t[["0"]])),
             data.frame(time = t, group = "A", log2_load = rnorm(length(t), mu(t), sd_t[as.character(t)])),
             data.frame(time = t, group = "B", log2_load = rnorm(length(t), mu(t), sd_t[as.character(t)])))
  x$group <- factor(x$group, levels = c("A", "B"))
  res <- prolif_fit(x, k = 6, n_sim = 2000, seed = r)
  p <- prolif_summary(res)$params
  out <- rbind(out, data.frame(difference_smooth = res$smooth_test$p[2] < 0.05, band = nrow(res$band_excl) > 0,
                               t(setNames(p$diff_low > 0 | p$diff_high < 0, p$key))))
}
cat("Share of", R, "experiments with no difference that were called different (%):\n")
print(round(100 * colMeans(out, na.rm = TRUE), 1))
